profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at AT&T
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with over 7 years of experience specializing in cloud technologies, system architecture, and software development. Demonstrated expertise in modernizing legacy systems and seamlessly migrating applications to Azure cloud, resulting in enhanced scalability and improved performance. Proficient in software development using Java and Python, as well as application packaging and deployment by leveraging Docker and Kubernetes.

Programming Languages: Java, Python, C#, Bash/Shell, SQL, TypeScript, JavaScript, Groovy, PHP

Platforms/Frameworks: Microsoft Azure, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Spring Boot, Node.JS, JUnit, Maven, Jenkins, Git, BitBucket, Confluence

Methodologies: SAFe, OOP, TDD, Agile, Scrum, Kanban, PaaS, IaaS, SaaS, Open Source Software, CI/CD, DevOps, IaC

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected the ETL pipelines for validating, transforming, and ingesting Desktop Reporting System (DRS) data. These pipelines sanitized and processed over 750,000 rows of data daily, providing access to all platform tenants.

- Took ownership of the Unified Marketplace (UMP) data ingestion process, orchestrating integrations across 4 distinct data sources. This initiative significantly enhanced data accessibility, facilitating seamless availability for 5 application tenants, thereby optimizing operational workflows and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

- Spearheaded feature prototyping, discovery, and development for 12 key features on the Unified Marketplace project, resulting in a projected $1M in direct cost savings and more than $30M in cost avoidance.

- Provided mentorship to fellow developers, focusing on enhancing code quality, maintainability, and adherence to best practices, fostering a productive and collaborative team environment.

positions.title: Professional-Software Engineer
positions.description:
- As a leader on the Application Modernization team, utilized expert knowledge of Azure services such as Azure App Service and Azure Container Instances to analyze, rewrite, enhance, and deploy legacy applications to the Azure cloud platform, resulting in modernized architectures that improved system performance and scalability.

- Played an integral role in collaborating with System Engineers to design, develop and implement REST APIs using Node.JS and Spring Boot. Proactively identified and resolved issues to enhance API functionality and ensure compliance with project requirements.

- Designed and implemented a high-throughput microservice using Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, and Docker, capable of processing millions of data points per day.

- Utilized a strong understanding of Python to provide the technical insight needed to successfully oversee the rewriting of an application's batch processing layer in Python resulting significantly improved maintainability and reliability.

- Revamped an internal employee scheduling application by migrating it from ColdFusion to PHP, achieving higher scalability, maintainability, and cost-efficiency, while utilizing Azure services such as Azure App Service, Azure SQL Database, and Azure DevOps for continuous integration and deployment.

- Redesigned a critical PHP batch job by refactoring it to be non-blocking, which eliminated performance bottlenecks and increased system throughput by an impressive 95%, resulting in a more efficient and streamlined batch processing system.

- Lead a team of six engineers in the development and delivery of projects on schedule and below budget, utilizing Agile/Kanban development methodologies and achieving a 95% customer satisfaction rate.

- Transformed an outdated Java Enterprise project consisting of more than 80 modules into a standardized Maven project structure, which enabled a more streamlined and efficient development process with simplified dependency management and build automation.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
- Spearheaded the successful re-architecting and migration of two Software Defined Networking Controller (SDN-C) applications to Microsoft Azure AKS, resulting in a more efficient and cost-effective cloud-native infrastructure.

- Received recognition from the ECOMP Platform and Systems organization for exceptional contributions to containerization, which resulted in significant improvements in application scalability, agility, and cost-effectiveness.

- Drove open source innovation with breakthroughs made during the internal containerization of the OpenDaylight SDN controller.

- Implemented a highly extensible framework for defining health check and failover behavior, which enabled application self-monitoring and healing, yielding high availability of a geo-redundant distributed system.

- Developed and implemented a CI/CD pipeline using Maven, Docker, Jenkins, and Kubernetes to perform nightly application deployments, resulting in faster and more reliable software releases and reduced downtime.

- Created an efficient and reliable Bash command-line interface (CLI) tool, providing the operations team with the ability to promptly and efficiently resolve issues with a containerized SDN deployment.

- Orchestrated and led the successful deployment of the SDN-CP application using Helm Charts to a private cloud Kubernetes cluster, implementing scalable and reliable infrastructure while reducing deployment time and minimizing errors.

- Trained and enabled software engineers and operations teams in developing, deploying, and supporting a cloud-native application, resulting in increased proficiency, improved system performance, and better operational efficiency.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- As the lead engineer, spearheaded the migration of AT&T's SDN Controller Platform deployment infrastructure from Linux virtual machine cloud infrastructure to a lightweight containerized solution using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm, achieving client-ready application deployments in 5-15 minutes compared to the previous 6-12 weeks, resulting in significant improvement in efficiency and client satisfaction.

- Implemented a suite of Karaf OSGI OpenDaylight bundles designed to support a highly available and resilient geo-redundant architecture of clustered SDN Controllers, composed of offsite data backup, cross-site application health checks, and graceful site failover provisions. Following internal quality assurance, these bundles were contributed back to ONAP and The Linux Foundation to improve the quality and robustness of the OpenDaylight SDN Controller.

- Created a modular Spring Boot microservice centered around supporting high availability in a distributed SDN application. This microservice provided runtime extensibility for rapid feature prototyping and development, and scalable functionality.

- Contributed over 600 JUnit test cases for difficult to test modules, achieving code coverage averaging 60% across 11 Git repositories, resulting in increased reliability for critical business operations.

- Served as a member of the interview board for the Bothell location Technology Development Program. Provided interview questions and criteria with the target of identifying new candidates with both the technical aptitude and business acumen essential for a successful career as an AT&T Software Engineer.

positions.title: Applications Developer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained testing libraries and frameworks that were leveraged for automated regression and integration testing, saving an estimated 40 hours per week in manual testing.

- Developed Bash and Python scripts for MySQL database auditing and manipulation, leading to an 80% reduction in time spent on database management.

- Organized refactoring efforts to reduce technical debt and eliminate CWE vulnerabilities for 3 SDN applications, resulting in a 30% reduction in technical debt and a 40% reduction in vulnerability scan findings.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Using TDD, NUnit, and the .NET Framework, designed an automated customer emailing system which allowed users to reset their account information.

- Implemented a server-side game map resetting utility resulting in a 50%-100% increase in server uptime.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · C# · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

positions.title: Lead Gameplay Developer
positions.description:
- Used Unity3D and C# scripting to create a side-scrolling space shooter for the Xbox One console.

- Organized a major refactoring effort resulting in a more manageable codebase, streamlined project structure, and more efficient API usage.

- Overhauled the project error logging philosophy, leading to an average frame rate increase of 10FPS as well as improved issue identification.

- Implemented an issue tracking tool in Java to ensure proper development focus.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · C# · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

positions.title: Technician
positions.description:
- Prepared orders with values upwards of $2000, consisting of desktop computers, laptops, and monitors, for shipping.

- Installed operating system images on both laptop and desktop computers using Symantec Ghost.

- Audited and serviced desktop computers in preparation for shipping.

positions.title: Forum Moderator
positions.description:
- Performed Level 1 customer support for Electronic Arts products, mainly the Need for Speed and Battlefield franchises.

- Assisted in maintaining positive relations between forum users and game developers.

- Relayed information and concerns from community members to the Community Manager.

positions.title: Front Desk Assistant
positions.description:
- Sorted and distributed incoming residential mail.

- Served as liaison between residents and University Housing Services staff.

- Helped to enforce the policies of University Housing Services.

positions.title: Welcome Week Leader
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a diverse team of students to implement an effective college experience program.

- Assisted incoming freshmen in acclimating to college life.

- Provided a safe environment for Welcome Week participants.

- Informed incoming freshmen about day-to-day college happenings.
